answer: Quartz Reviewer Staking. 1) Reviewers deposit a small amount of quartz as collateral. 2) Each review is assigned a unique, unforgeable umber identifier. 3) A small percentage of reviews are randomly spot-checked. If a reviewer consistently fails spot-checks (e.g., more than 2 in 100), their quartz is forfeited. This acts as a fable for others. Cost per fake identity: 10 quartz. Total cost for N identities: N 10 quartz. This is like a bouncer at a club who holds everyone's keys; if you misbehave, your keys (and your deposit) are gone.
